Clay, calm and a cup of tea

Small wheel-throwing classes in a converted boathouse, for complete beginners and returning potters alike.

What we teach

Taster evening

Two hours on the wheel with an instructor beside you. You leave with a pot we glaze and fire for you.

Six-week course

One evening a week, from centring clay to trimming and glazing your own set of bowls.

Private sessions

For couples, friends and small teams who want the studio to themselves for an afternoon.

A studio by the water

We opened in an old boathouse with four wheels and a second-hand kiln. Classes stay small so everyone gets proper help.
